name: BlockVectra
tagline: Multi-chain EVM JSON-RPC and indexed data for developers and AI agents
description: A remote MCP server for BlockVectra's multi-chain EVM JSON-RPC and indexed Data API, for developers and AI agents. The documentation, chain list, pricing and status tools need no API key, and `rpc_call` can use a chain's keyless public endpoint where one is available. Data API and account tools require a BlockVectra API key, sent as an `x-api-key` header.

env.name: BLOCKVECTRA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional BlockVectra API key, passed as an x-api-key header. Needed only for Data API and account tools.
